questions.question: Write various scripts of Syriac language and its origin?
questions.solution_html:
• Different scripts in Syriac.
  • Syriac has three scripts- Estrangela- East Syriac- West Syriac
  • The ancient form of Syriac script is Estrangela- East Syriac developed by Nisibis- West
  • Syriac developed by school of Edessa.
questions.final_answer: Syriac developed by school of Edessa

questions.question: What are the main events described in the Act of Thomas?
questions.solution_html:
• Act of Thomas
  • A Syriac text written on 3rd century at Edessa- This text describe the Apostle’s mission in
  • India and narrative is set out 13 sections called acts- The work provides dramatic
  • narratives of Thomas miraculous evangelistic adventures in India- Two poems
  • incorporated with this text: Hymn of Bride and Hymn of Pearl.
questions.final_answer: incorporated with this text: Hymn of Bride and Hymn of Pearl
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Define the ancient Syriac text ‘Peshitta Old Testament’
questions.solution_html:
• Syriac translation of the Bible is known as Peshitta- word meaning is simple or plain
  • Peshitta OT is not a single work- Many different scholars- many translators
questions.final_answer: Syriac translation of the Bible is known as Peshitta- word meaning is simple or plain

questions.question: Discuss the historical and cultural significance of the Story of Ahikar.
questions.solution_html:
• Wisdom of Ahiqar
  • The story of the Aramean sage Ahiqar is perhaps the most widely circulated piece of
  • Aramaic literature- He had no sons- He adopted sister’s son- Nadan plotted against his
  • uncle- Ahiqar was sentenced to death and handed over to the executioner- But
  • executionaer saved his life and revealed the truth to the king- So Nadan was punished
questions.final_answer: executionaer saved his life and revealed the truth to the king- So Nadan was punished
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Discuss the theme of jealousy and rivalry in the story of Abel and Cain.
questions.solution_html:
• Story of abel and Cain: Genesis 4: 1-16
  • Abel and Cain are brothers- Abel was a keeper of sheep and Cain was a tiller- both are
  • submitting their offerings- but Lord regards Abel’s offerings- Cain was very angry- Cain
  • rose up against his brother and killed him
questions.final_answer: rose up against his brother and killed him
